mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead. Please note that the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will bring an overnight low of 49 degrees with rain predicted.

The city has a few updates to keep you informed. Alternate-side winter parking regulations take effect from November 20 through April 1 to assist with snow removal, and the Verona Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving.

There is plenty happening in town! We have Main Street Trick-or-Treat happening today at Hometown Junction Park, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to a vehicle stopped at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I.
If you are looking for a dessert, head over to Culver's to try the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
